summary.text: Jason Kyle is a Republican state representative from Utah House District 8 who has served since 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Kyle is a chemical engineer and manager who lives in Huntsville.

paragraphs.text: Jason Kyle was born in Utah and lives in Huntsville, Utah.
He earned a bachelor's degree in chemical engineering from the University of Utah.

His career experience includes working as a chemical engineer and environmental manager at Varian Medical Systems and as a corporate environmental, health and safety manager and production manager at Varex Imaging Corporation.
Kyle took office in 2023, succeeding Steve Waldrip in District 8.
